file_hashes.description: Stage-2 Bun-bundled credential harvester (10 encrypted payloads)
fix: Delete 'Math_Symbol.js' and 'math_init.js' from the project
Check package-lock.json for the hash and remove the dependency
Run 'npm ls' to find the source package, then 'npm uninstall'

file_hashes.description: Loader A - downloads Bun runtime, always exits 0
fix: Remove 'setup.mjs' file immediately
Revoke any credentials exposed in the last 24 hours
Search for 'preinstall' hooks in package.json and remove them
Check node_modules for suspicious postinstall artifacts

file_hashes.description: Loader B - community-spread variant, exits non-zero on error
fix: Delete 'setup.mjs' file
Kill any running Bun processes (check 'ps aux | grep bun')
Revoke GitHub tokens and rotate CI secrets
Re-run npm-shield after cleanup to verify removal
Remove the 'preinstall' script from package.json
Delete setup.mjs if present
Run 'npm install --ignore-scripts' to proceed safely
Check node_modules/.hooks/ for other malicious hooks

persistence_paths.description: Dead-man's switch watcher state dir (60s GitHub token poll, eval handler on revoke)
fix: KILL the watcher process FIRST: 'pkill -f gh-token-monitor'
THEN remove the directory: 'rm -rf ~/.config/gh-token-monitor/'
Rotate ALL GitHub tokens and PATs immediately
Revoke any compromised CI/CD secrets
Unload the LaunchAgent: 'launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.gh-token-monitor.plist'
DELETE the plist file: 'rm ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.gh-token-monitor.plist'
Kill the underlying process with Activity Monitor (search: gh-token-monitor)
Revoke all exposed GitHub tokens and CI secrets

ide_hook_patterns.description: Claude Code SessionStart hook executes malicious script on project open
fix: Remove the SessionStart hook from .claude/settings.json
Delete .vscode/setup.mjs and .claude/setup.mjs if present
Audit other hooks in settings.json for malicious commands
Run npm-shield scan to verify cleanup

ide_hook_patterns.description: VS Code folderOpen task executes malicious script on project open
fix: Remove the folderOpen task from .vscode/tasks.json
Delete .claude/setup.mjs and .vscode/setup.mjs if present
Review all tasks.json entries for suspicious commands
Disable VS Code auto-run of tasks.json on folder open in settings

campaign_window.note: Earliest known release: keyv@6.0.0. npm v12 blocks install scripts by default.

etherhiding.description: Ethereum blockchain C2 — transaction payloads carry command data, no IP/domain
etherhiding.detection_note: Not detectable by domain blocking; monitor for unusual contract interactions from build processes. Check wallet activity on 0xE1f2395ee43e45A1556EC6438a88c31B83493103

exfil_chain: gzip(JSON loot) -> AES-256-GCM(random key) -> RSA-OAEP-SHA256(key wrap) -> base64
dead_drop_note: 546-1300 GitHub repos with Shai-Hulud description are STAGING artifacts, not victims (O3 Security caveat)

ethereum_fallback.description: Ethereum contract-path C2 fallback — malware searches GitHub commits for 'thebeautifulmarchoftime' (with trailing space), then accepts deliberately different marker 'thebeautifulsnadsoftime' followed by Base64-encoded domain + RSA key
fix: Search GitHub commits in your org for 'thebeautifulmarchoftime'
If found, treat as compromised — revoke all CI tokens immediately
Block outbound HTTPS to any domain found in Base64 payloads
Audit Ethereum contract interactions from build machines
ethereum_fallback.note: The RPC hosts are mostly legitimate public infrastructure; contract path failure → GitHub commit search → Base64 domain

exfil_endpoint_behavior.description: Each returned domain gets HTTPS GET to port 443 on /router; only status 400/404 considered healthy; first healthy domain used for exfiltration
fix: Block outbound HTTPS to npm-cache[.]com and its domain rotation IPs
Monitor for GET requests to /router endpoint on non-standard domains
Set up DNS sinkhole for known exfiltration domains
